# apple_game_center_matchmaking_rule (Resource)

Adds a rule to a Game Center matchmaking rule set: an expression over the players' match requests that decides who can be matched. Import it with `<rule_set_id>/<id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_game_center_matchmaking_rule" "skill" {
  rule_set_id    = apple_game_center_matchmaking_rule_set.ranked.id
  reference_name = "skill"
  type           = "DISTANCE"
  description    = "Match players of similar skill."
  expression     = "abs(requests[0].properties.skill - requests[1].properties.skill)"
  weight         = 0.5
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) Description of the rule.
- `expression` (String) Expression in the rule language, e.g. `requests[0].properties.mode == requests[1].properties.mode`.
- `reference_name` (String) Name of the rule. Changing it creates a new rule.
- `rule_set_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the rule set, e.g. `apple_game_center_matchmaking_rule_set.example.id`.
- `type` (String) Kind of rule: `COMPATIBLE`, `DISTANCE`, `MATCH`, `TEAM`. Changing it creates a new rule.

### Optional

- `weight` (Number) Weight of a `DISTANCE` rule against the others.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the matchmaking rule.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_game_center_matchmaking_rule.example
  identity = {
    rule_set_id = "2e4a6c8b-0d1f-4b3a-9c5e-7f8a9b0c1d2f"
    id          = "8a0c2e4f-6b1d-4a3c-8e5f-1a2b3c4d5e6f"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the matchmaking rule.
- `rule_set_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the matchmaking rule set.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_game_center_matchmaking_rule.example 2e4a6c8b-0d1f-4b3a-9c5e-7f8a9b0c1d2f/8a0c2e4f-6b1d-4a3c-8e5f-1a2b3c4d5e6f
```
